archive.catalogue_description: Description Hey everyone Finally finished my first ever zombie map Verletzung aka Candyland. So this map dosnt really have a story because is just a reimage of ascension from Blops. Content – Decent amount of detail – Blops/Orig perks – Buyable ending – W.aW. weapons with P.a.P – Drops/Power ups (Full Map) – 34 window zombies NO risers – NO dogs – !0 Zones/ 32 portals-cells – Online Credits/Thanks – All mappig and scripting done by me – Treminaor – General Help/Video tuts (zones) – SajeOne – General Help/Video tuts (zones) – BlackJackJonny – Video tuts (portals/curved terrain patch/blending/and probably more) Props to you! – ZK – Video tuts ( Very very good video tuts) Props to you! – Bamskater 33 – Blops perks – Tom_BMX – Buyable ending – Everyone else who made me carry on when I wanted to shot my p.c. THANK! HOPE YOU ENJOY!!!

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). PROVISIONAL: archive/corpus-ignore.json was missing, so corpus boilerplate was not subtracted and this finish may be a shared-script name; scan_maps.py --keep-existing rewrites this manifest.
